name: Asakura Takashi
source: Class rep for Ice Creasemas. He may seem like he’s just winging his job, but he’s actually quite smart and well-spoken. Is able to talk himself out of trouble during the Content Restriction Meeting. One of the most dependable students to have as an ally.
